description: This file contains unit tests for RTF rendering functionality in the MigraDoc library, including rendering of headings, borders, images, and complex table tab stops. It uses the Xunit testing framework and references external libraries such as PdfSharp and MigraDoc.

classes.name: RtfRendererTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for verifying RTF rendering in MigraDoc, including document creation, styling, tables, and images.
